title: (RHEA-2025:19385) Red Hat build of Keycloak 26.4.2 Images Enhancement Update
portal_summary: New images are available for Red Hat build of Keycloak 26.4.2 and Red Hat build of Keycloak 26.4.2 Operator, running on OpenShift Container Platform
portal_synopsis: Red Hat build of Keycloak 26.4.2 Images Enhancement Update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat build of Keycloak|Red Hat build of Keycloak|Text-only Advisories|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat build of Keycloak is an integrated sign-on solution, available as a Red Hat JBoss Middleware for OpenShift containerized image. The Red Hat build of Keycloak for OpenShift image provides an authentication server that you can use to log in centrally, log out, and register. You can also manage user accounts for web applications, mobile applications, and RESTful web services.
Red Hat build of Keycloak Operator for OpenShift simplifies deployment and management of Keycloak 26.4.2 clusters.

This erratum releases new images for Red Hat build of Keycloak 26.4.2 for use within the OpenShift Container Platform cloud computing Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) for on-premise or private cloud deployments, aligning with the standalone product release.
